newsitem.title: USA: Texas Star Resources changes name.
newsitem.headline: Texas Star Resources changes name.

text.p: Texas Star Resources Corp said on Monday that the company's shareholders approved a resolution to change the company's name to Star Resources Corp.
There will be no consolidation of the issued and outstanding shares of the company, the company said.
The name change and the effective date of the change is subject to acceptance for filing by the Vancouver Stock Exchange, the company said.
